title: Eureka: Task-Conditioned Meta-Agent Orchestration for Scientific Discovery
title_zh: Eureka：面向科学发现的任务条件化元智能体编排
abstract_en: We present Eureka, a task-conditioned Meta-Agent architecture that compiles long-horizon tasks into dynamic obligation graphs with explicit acceptance semantics. During execution, Eureka forms Macro-Agents with specialized state, memory, operators, tools, verifiers, and local topology via receding-horizon planning, architecture promotion, and minimal-sufficient compilation. When bottlenecks recur, cost-benefit-gated evolution updates the local architecture under constraints. Theoretically, we establish results on regret, planning invalidation, amortization, subtree interfaces, serializability, and verification. Experimentally, Eureka completes 170/170 recursive tasks and generates 3,948 certificates with no false acceptances. Active context compresses median input from 9,490 to 4,005 tokens; incremental processing avoids 65.38% recomputation across 12,000 tasks; 16,000 concurrent executions serialize consistently. The same Meta-Agent instantiates a Theory-Discovery Agent and a Math/Conjecture Agent. The former yields structural results in quantum-process and spacetime theory. The latter identifies bottlenecks in Riemann Hypothesis research and advances a positivity certificate for Suzuki's localized Weil quadratic form to 0 < a <= 69/200 = 0.345, reaching ~99.55% of (log 2)/2. These results suggest that scientific-agent capability depends not only on the base model but on whether an architecture can be formed to match the task's cognitive structure.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 Eureka，一种任务条件化 Meta-Agent 架构，可将长程任务编译为具有显式验收语义的动态义务图（obligation graph）。执行过程中，Eureka 通过滚动时域规划（receding-horizon planning）、架构提升（architecture promotion）和最小充分编译（minimal-sufficient compilation），动态构建具备专用状态、记忆、算子、工具、验证器及局部拓扑的 Macro-Agent。当瓶颈反复出现时，系统通过成本—收益门控的演化机制，在约束条件下更新局部架构。理论上，论文给出了关于遗憾界、规划失效、摊销、子树接口、可串行化与验证的分析结果。实验中，Eureka 完成了 170/170 个递归任务，生成 3,948 份证书且未出现错误接受；将活跃上下文的中位输入量从 9,490 tokens 压缩至 4,005 tokens；在 12,000 个任务上通过增量处理避免了 65.38% 的重复计算，并使 16,000 个并发执行保持一致的串行化结果。同一 Meta-Agent 还可实例化为 Theory-Discovery Agent 和 Math/Conjecture Agent：前者在量子过程与时空理论中得到结构性结果，后者分析 Riemann Hypothesis 研究瓶颈，并将 Suzuki 局部化 Weil 二次型的正性证书推进至 0 < a ≤ 69/200 = 0.345，达到 (log 2)/2 的约 99.55%。论文据此认为，科学智能体能力不仅取决于基础模型，也取决于架构能否匹配任务的认知结构。
key_points_zh: 提出任务条件化 Meta-Agent，将长程任务表示为带显式验收条件的动态义务图，并按需组建专用 Macro-Agent。
通过滚动时域规划、最小充分编译及成本—收益门控演化，使智能体架构能够针对反复出现的任务瓶颈自适应调整。
论文报告完成全部 170 个递归任务，生成 3,948 份证书且无错误接受，并证明系统具备可验证性与并发可串行化等性质。
活跃上下文压缩使中位输入由 9,490 降至 4,005 tokens；增量处理在 12,000 个任务中避免 65.38% 的重复计算。
Eureka 可复用为理论发现与数学猜想智能体，并报告了量子过程、时空理论及 Riemann Hypothesis 相关正性证书方面的进展。

llm_assessment.comment: Eureka proposes an ambitious task-compiled orchestration architecture, but its unusually broad claims require stronger comparative evidence to establish generality.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: Eureka提出了雄心勃勃的任务编译式编排架构，但其异常广泛的主张仍需更强的对比证据来证明通用性。
